description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tellah
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Forbidden Meteor (0~2), removed after using Forbidden Meteor two times

description.name: Forbidden Meteor Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Forbidden Meteor level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tellah]

description.name: Forbidden Meteor Level
description.text: Keeps track of Forbidden Meteor level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tellah]
